title: Procedures.
bodyText: Any county modifying its zoning ordinance or enacting a local law pursuant to this part shall follow the procedure for adopting and amending its ordinances.
bodyHtml: [§46-164]  Procedures.  Any county modifying its zoning ordinance or enacting a local law pursuant to this part shall follow the procedure for adopting and amending its ordinances. [L 1998, c 296, pt of §1]
